decisions.reason: The DPA management tool has its own page, several models and positive agency feedback, and it fits the firm's announced compliance direction, so withdrawing it would contradict that public commitment.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page and central to the agency-focused strategy, it carries heavy investment and visible commitment, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
The configurable managed plan sits close to the core hosting offer, costs little to maintain, has its own page and shows no evidence of failure, so management has no reason to write it off.
